audit.why: Hallowed Mist is 22/21/20/19/18 — that gap is the entire matchup and it was never quantified. Skip 'n Slash is 13/12.5/12/11.5/11 and Riot's text says the cooldown is partially refunded if she hits an enemy during the window, so it is short and gets shorter, not long. A Thousand Cuts heals her for a portion of the damage it deals to champions, which is exactly the extended trade this page tells you to force.

notes: No suspect names in this packet and none found. Agreeing with the mirror agent's flag and extending it: the kit file's derived 'grounding' on Obliterate is not in Riot's Q text, so I asserted nothing about it stopping Skip 'n Slash. UNVERIFIED and left alone: wants.you[1] says 'Land Q + E to pull her out of Hallowed Mist', and the mid text implies the same. Whether Death's Grasp — an untargeted area pull — affects a champion who is untargetable to units outside the mist is not answerable from Riot's text on either kit, and it is the single most load-bearing claim on this page. I deliberately phrased whys[3] as stepping in and pulling her after the mist drops rather than pulling her out of it, so the advice is correct either way. This one needs a human answer, and it is in questionsForUser.
